name: TANTALUS
source:
After taking over the positions of his father and grandfather and becoming the new head of the family, Cao Rui discovers that his father, who should have died, has reappeared in front of him...

[From the dev's weibo]
translation:
接替父亲和祖父的位置，成为新的一家之主后，曹睿却发现，本该死去的父亲又出现在了自己的面前……

【来自开发者微博】
